# 3. Turn extraction

## 3a. ChatGPT — JSON thread walk (no DOM at all)

`buildThread()` picks the currently-selected branch:

```js
function buildThread(data) {
  if (Array.isArray(data.linear_conversation) && data.linear_conversation.length > 0) {
    return data.linear_conversation.map((node) => node.message).filter(Boolean);
  }
  // /backend-api/conversation 只回 mapping + current_node，得自己往上走。
  const mapping = data.mapping || {};
  const thread = [];
  const guard = new Set();
  let id = data.current_node;
  while (id && mapping[id] && !guard.has(id)) {
    guard.add(id);
    if (mapping[id].message) thread.push(mapping[id].message);
    id = mapping[id].parent;
  }
  return thread.reverse();
}
```

Visibility filter + role mapping:

```js
function visibleMessages(messages, opts) {
  return messages.filter((message) => {
    if (message.metadata?.is_visually_hidden_from_conversation) return false;
    const role = message.author?.role;
    if (role === 'system') return false;
    const contentType = message.content?.content_type;
    if (SKIP_CONTENT_TYPES.has(contentType)) return false;
    if (THINKING_CONTENT_TYPES.has(contentType)) return opts.includeThinking;
    const isToolTraffic = role === 'tool' || (message.recipient && message.recipient !== 'all');
    if (isToolTraffic) return opts.includeTools;
    return true;
  });
}

function roleOf(message) {
  const role = message.author?.role;
  if (role === 'user') return 'User';
  if (role === 'tool') return `Tool (${message.author?.name || 'tool'})`;
  if (message.recipient && message.recipient !== 'all') return `Assistant → ${message.recipient}`;
  return 'Assistant';
}
```

`textOf(message)` switches on `content_type` (`text`/`multimodal_text`/`code`/`execution_output`/`thoughts`/`reasoning_recap`/`tether_*`) and, crucially, the default branch never silently drops data:

```js
default:
  // 未知型態（Deep Research、canvas 之類的新東西）不靜默丟掉，寧可留 JSON。
  if (parts && parts.length > 0) return parts.join('\n\n');
  if (typeof content.text === 'string') return content.text;
  return fence(JSON.stringify(content, null, 2), 'json');
```

Citations are private-use-area sentinels, replaced by index (the comment documents a real bug):

```js
const CITATION_SENTINEL = /\uE200[\s\S]*?\uE201/g;

function applyCitations(text, message) {
  const refs = (message.metadata?.content_references || []).filter(
    (ref) => typeof ref.matched_text === 'string' && ref.matched_text.trim() !== ''
  );
  let out = text;
  // 由後往前換，前面那些 start_idx 才不會被前一次替換推掉。
  for (const ref of [...refs].sort((a, b) => (b.start_idx ?? -1) - (a.start_idx ?? -1))) {
    const alt = ref.alt || '';
    const { start_idx: start, end_idx: end } = ref;
    if (Number.isInteger(start) && Number.isInteger(end) && out.slice(start, end) === ref.matched_text) {
      out = out.slice(0, start) + alt + out.slice(end);
      continue;
    }
    const at = out.indexOf(ref.matched_text);
    if (at >= 0) out = out.slice(0, at) + alt + out.slice(at + ref.matched_text.length);
  }
  return out.replace(CITATION_SENTINEL, '');
}
```

`normalize()` is the only adapter surface the shared layer sees:

```js
function normalize(data, ctx, opts) {
  const sections = visibleMessages(buildThread(data), opts).map((message) => ({
    role: roleOf(message),
    model: roleOf(message) === 'Assistant' ? message.metadata?.model_slug || '' : '',
    time: message.create_time,
    body: applyCitations(textOf(message), message),
  }));

  return {
    source: 'chatgpt',
    sourceLabel: 'ChatGPT',
    title: data.title || 'ChatGPT conversation',
    url: ctx.url,
    ids: { conversation_id: data.conversation_id || data.id || '' },
    model: data.default_model_slug || '',
    createdAt: data.create_time,
    sections,
  };
}
```

## 3b. Claude — block-typed content

`buildThread()` detects branching by counting duplicate `parent_message_uuid`, then either sorts by `index` or walks parents backwards. Body assembly:

```js
function blockToText(block, opts) {
  if (!block || typeof block !== 'object') return '';
  switch (block.type) {
    case 'text': {
      const body = String(block.text ?? '');
      const sources = sourcesBlock(citationTargets(block));
      return sources ? `${body}\n\n${sources}` : body;
    }
    case 'thinking':
      return opts.includeThinking ? thinkingText(block) : '';
    case 'tool_use': {
      if (!opts.includeTools) return '';
      const name = block.name || 'tool';
      const input = block.input ?? block.message ?? null;
      return input === null ? `**Tool call: ${name}**` : `**Tool call: ${name}**\n\n${jsonFence(input)}`;
    }
    case 'tool_result': {
      if (!opts.includeTools) return '';
      return `**Tool result: ${block.name || 'tool'}**\n\n${toolResultText(block)}`;
    }
    default:
      if (typeof block.text === 'string' && block.text.trim()) return block.text;
      return jsonFence(block);
  }
}

function roleOf(message) {
  return message.sender === 'human' ? 'User' : 'Assistant';
}
```

Plus `attachmentLines()` prepending a `**附件**` list, and a fallback to `message.text` when `content[]` yields nothing.

## 3c. Copilot — shape-based discovery (most relevant if Gemini's payload shape is unknown)

Copilot doesn't hard-code the response envelope. It deep-scans any captured JSON for the message array:

```js
/** 深掃找「訊息列表」：元素同時有 author/sender 與 content 的陣列，取最長的那個。 */
function findMessageList(root, maxDepth = 6) {
  const seen = new Set();
  let best = null;

  const isMessage = (item) =>
    !!item && typeof item === 'object' &&
    (item.author || item.sender || item.role) &&
    (Array.isArray(item.content) || typeof item.content === 'string' || 'text' in item);

  const walk = (node, depth) => {
    if (!node || typeof node !== 'object' || depth > maxDepth || seen.has(node)) return;
    seen.add(node);
    if (Array.isArray(node)) {
      if (node.length > 0 && node.every(isMessage)) {
        if (!best || node.length > best.length) best = node;
        return;
      }
      for (const item of node) walk(item, depth + 1);
      return;
    }
    for (const value of Object.values(node)) walk(value, depth + 1);
  };

  walk(root, 0);
  return best;
}

function roleOf(message) {
  const type = String(message.author?.type || message.author || message.sender || message.role || '');
  if (/human|user/i.test(type)) return 'User';
  if (/^(ai|bot|assistant|copilot)$/i.test(type)) return 'Assistant';
  return type ? type[0].toUpperCase() + type.slice(1) : 'Unknown';
}
```

Its `partToText` handles `text` / `image` / `citation` (pushed into a `citations` array that becomes a `sourcesBlock`) / `chainOfThought`, with the unknown-part default gated behind `includeTools`. `normalize()` sorts by `createdAt || created_at` before mapping.

## 3d. m365 — the only DOM scraper, and it has its own HTML→Markdown converter

**There is no shared HTML→Markdown helper.** `shared/chat-export.js` deliberately never touches the DOM. The only HTML converter in the repo is private to `m365-copilot-export-markdown.user.js` (lines 791–924): `nodeToMarkdown(node, depth)` + `htmlToMarkdown(el)`.

`nodeToMarkdown` is a recursive `switch (tag)` covering: text nodes (whitespace-collapsed), dropped nodes (`script/style/svg/button/textarea`), `br`, `hr`, `strong|b`, `em|i`, `del|s`, `a`, `img`, inline `code` vs `pre>code`, `pre` (language from `/language-([\w+-]+)/` on the `<code>` class), `h1`–`h6`, `blockquote`, `ul|ol` (with `depth`-based indentation and `\n` → `\n  ` re-indent inside `li`), `table` (header row + `---` separator), block-ish `p|div|section|article|li` → `\n\n…\n\n`, default → children. Key excerpts:

```js
case 'strong':
case 'b': {
  const text = kids().trim();
  return text ? `**${text}**` : '';   // 空的行內標記要整個丟掉，不然 icon/spacer 會變成孤兒 `**`
}
case 'pre': {
  const className = node.querySelector('code')?.className || '';
  const lang = /language-([\w+-]+)/.exec(className)?.[1] || '';
  return `\n\n\`\`\`${lang}\n${(node.textContent || '').replace(/\n+$/, '')}\n\`\`\`\n\n`;
}
case 'ul':
case 'ol': {
  const items = Array.from(node.children).filter((child) => child.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'li');
  const body = items.map((li, index) => {
    const marker = tag === 'ol' ? `${index + 1}.` : '-';
    const text = nodeToMarkdown(li, depth + 1).trim().replace(/\n/g, '\n  ');
    return `${'  '.repeat(depth)}${marker} ${text}`;
  }).join('\n');
  return `\n\n${body}\n\n`;
}
case 'table': {
  const rows = Array.from(node.querySelectorAll('tr'));
  if (rows.length === 0) return '';
  const toCells = (tr) => Array.from(tr.children).map((cell) => nodeToMarkdown(cell, depth).trim() || ' ');
  const head = toCells(rows[0]);
  const lines = [
    `| ${head.join(' | ')} |`,
    `| ${head.map(() => '---').join(' | ')} |`,
    ...rows.slice(1).map((tr) => `| ${toCells(tr).join(' | ')} |`),
  ];
  return `\n\n${lines.join('\n')}\n\n`;
}
```

Noise stripping + normalization (this is the function to copy for Gemini):

```js
const DOM_NOISE_SELECTOR = [
  '[class*="accessibleHeading"]',   // 螢幕閱讀器的 "You said:" / "Copilot said:"
  '[class*="__actions"]',           // 複製／讚／倒讚那排按鈕
  '[class*="line-number" i]',
  '[class*="lineNumber" i]',
  '[class*="linenumber" i]',
  '[class*="gutter" i]',
  '[data-line-number]',
  'button',
  '[role="button"]',
  '[aria-hidden="true"]',
].join(', ');

function htmlToMarkdown(el) {
  // 在 clone 上動刀，不要碰到真的頁面
  const clone = el.cloneNode(true);
  for (const noise of clone.querySelectorAll(DOM_NOISE_SELECTOR)) noise.remove();
  return nodeToMarkdown(clone)
    .replace(/[ \t]+\n/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
    .trim();
}
```

Known-layout extraction (preferred over heuristics):

```js
const M365_MESSAGE_SELECTOR = '.fai-UserMessage, .fai-CopilotMessage';
const M365_BODY_SELECTOR = '.fai-UserMessage__message, .fai-CopilotMessage__content';

function fromKnownDomLayout(ownRoot) {
  const nodes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(M365_MESSAGE_SELECTOR)).filter(
    (el) => !(ownRoot && ownRoot.contains(el))
  );
  if (nodes.length === 0) return null;

  const messages = nodes.map((el) => {
    const className = typeof el.className === 'string' ? el.className : '';
    const author = /fai-UserMessage/.test(className) ? 'user' : 'assistant';
    const body = el.querySelector(M365_BODY_SELECTOR) || el;   // 找不到就退回整個訊息框
    return { author, text: htmlToMarkdown(body), createdAt: '' };
  }).filter((message) => message.text.trim());

  if (messages.length === 0) return null;
  rememberAttempt('DOM 掃描', `用 M365 Copilot 已知的 class 抓到 ${messages.length} 則訊息`);
  return messages;
}
```

The generic heuristic path (`fromDom({ knownLayoutOnly: false })`) additionally: filters `*` by `DOM_MESSAGE_HINT_RE = /message|chat-turn|conversation-turn|chatbubble|bubble/i` on `data-testid`/class/id, groups by `domSignature()` for diagnostics, keeps only outermost candidates, then **descends while `nodes.length === 1`** (up to 10 levels) to avoid collapsing the whole conversation into one message, sorts by `compareDocumentPosition`, infers role via `domRoleOf()` (walks up 4 ancestors testing `data-testid`/`aria-label`/`data-author`/`className` against `/user|human|self|outgoing|\bsent\b/i` vs `/assistant|copilot|\bbot\b|response|incoming|received/i`), and falls back to alternating user/assistant while recording that the roles were guessed.

---

# 4. Action exposure and output — both menu and injected panel

The panel comes from `shared/export-ui.js`'s `createExportPanel()`. `ACTIONS` is defined once and reused for both the panel and the menu:

```js
const ACTIONS = [
  { label: 'Copy Markdown', run: () => doExport({ mode: 'transcript', to: 'clipboard' }) },
  { label: 'Copy Agent Handoff', run: () => doExport({ mode: 'handoff', to: 'clipboard' }) },
  { label: 'Download .md', run: () => doExport({ mode: 'transcript', to: 'file' }) },
  { label: 'Download .json', run: () => doExport({ mode: 'json', to: 'file' }) },
  // m365 only: { label: 'Copy Diagnostics', run: copyDiagnostics },
];

const ui = createExportPanel({
  ns: NS,
  buttonLabel: '⇩ Export MD',
  actions: ACTIONS,
  toggles: [
    { label: '含 thinking / reasoning', get: () => settings.includeThinking,
      set: (value) => setSetting('includeThinking', value) },
    { label: '含工具呼叫與搜尋結果', get: () => settings.includeTools,
      set: (value) => setSetting('includeTools', value) },
  ],
  shareInput: {
    placeholder: '貼上任意 share URL…',
    buttonLabel: 'Copy from share URL',   // claude/copilot/m365: 'Open & copy share URL'
    onSubmit: exportFromShareUrl,
  },
  storage: { get: (key, fallback) => GM_getValue(key, fallback), set: GM_setValue },
  onStatus: log,
});

function registerMenu() {
  for (const action of ACTIONS) {
    // 不要用 accessKey —— 那是 Tampermonkey 限定的。
    GM_registerMenuCommand(action.label, () => {
      ui.openPanel();
      action.run();
    });
  }
  GM_registerMenuCommand('Export from share URL…', () => {
    ui.openPanel();
    const raw = prompt('貼上 ChatGPT share URL：');
    if (raw) exportFromShareUrl(raw);
  });
  GM_registerMenuCommand('Toggle thinking / reasoning', () => {
    setSetting('includeThinking', !settings.includeThinking);
    ui.openPanel();
    ui.setStatus(`thinking / reasoning：${settings.includeThinking ? '含' : '不含'}`);
  });
  GM_registerMenuCommand('Toggle 工具呼叫與搜尋結果', () => { /* same shape */ });
  GM_registerMenuCommand('Reset button position', () => {
    ui.mount();
    ui.resetPosition();
    ui.openPanel();
    ui.setStatus('按鈕已放回右下角');
  });
}
```

Output writing — `doExport()` is nearly identical across all four:

```js
async function doExport({ mode, to, ids }) {
  ui.setStatus('讀取對話…');
  try {
    const target = ids || currentIds();
    const { data, source } = await resolveConversation(target);
    const url = target.shareId ? `${location.origin}/share/${target.shareId}` : location.href;

    const doc = normalize(data, { url }, settings);
    const text =
      mode === 'json'
        ? JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)
        : renderTranscript(doc, { ...settings, handoff: mode === 'handoff', exporter: EXPORTER });

    if (to === 'clipboard') {
      GM_setClipboard(text, 'text');
      ui.setStatus(`已複製 ${text.length.toLocaleString()} 字（來源：${source}）`);
    } else {
      downloadText(
        filenameFor(doc, mode === 'json' ? 'json' : 'md'),
        text,
        mode === 'json' ? 'application/json;charset=utf-8' : 'text/markdown;charset=utf-8'
      );
      ui.setStatus(`已下載（來源：${source}）`);
    }
    log('exported', { mode, to, source, length: text.length });
  } catch (error) {
    ui.setStatus(`失敗：${error.message}`);
    log('export failed:', error);
  }
}
```

So: clipboard via `GM_setClipboard(text, 'text')`, file via `downloadText()` from `shared/chat-export.js` (Blob + object URL, needs no grant). Errors are surfaced in the panel status line, never thrown to the page.

Cross-tab share handoff (claude / copilot / m365, since those share pages can't be fetched twice):

```js
function exportFromShareUrl(raw) {
  const shareId = shareIdFromUrl(raw);
  if (!shareId) { ui.setStatus('這不像 share URL（要有 /share/<id>）。'); return; }
  if (shareId === currentIds().shareId) { doExport({ mode: 'transcript', to: 'clipboard' }); return; }
  GM_setValue(PENDING_KEY, { shareId, expires: Date.now() + 120_000 });
  GM_openInTab(`${location.origin}/share/${shareId}`, { active: true });
  ui.setStatus('已開新分頁，那邊載完就會自動複製。');
}

async function consumePending() {
  const pending = GM_getValue(PENDING_KEY, null);
  if (!pending || typeof pending !== 'object') return;
  const { shareId } = currentIds();
  if (!shareId || pending.shareId !== shareId) return;
  GM_deleteValue(PENDING_KEY); // 一次性：先消耗再執行，免得失敗時每次開頁都重跑
  if (Date.now() > (pending.expires ?? 0)) return;
  ui.openPanel();
  await doExport({ mode: 'transcript', to: 'clipboard' });
}
```

# 5. API-first vs DOM-fallback strategy

The repo's stated rule (chatgpt README, claude header, m365 header): **never silently fall back to DOM scraping — a truncated transcript is worse than none, because the agent can't tell what's missing.**

| script | sources, in order | DOM fallback? |
|---|---|---|
| chatgpt | 1. `document-start` fetch capture of `/backend-api/(conversation\|share)/` → 2. `window.__reactRouterContext.state.loaderData` shape-scan → 3. self-fetch `/backend-api/conversation/<id>` with bearer from `/api/auth/session` → 4. same-origin hidden iframe loading `/share/<id>`, poll its router state, deep-clone before removing | No — throws |
| claude | 1. fetch capture of `/api/(chat_snapshots/\|organizations/<org>/chat_conversations/)` (only the page's own first request passes Cloudflare) → 2. self-fetch same endpoints (`/api/organizations` for the org id) | No — throws |
| copilot | 1. fetch **and** XHR capture of `/c/api/(shares\|conversations)/` + `Authorization` header harvesting → 2. self-fetch `/c/api/shares/<id>`, `…?api-version=2`, `/c/api/conversations/<id>/history?api-version=2`, retrying once after `POST /c/api/start` on 401/403 | No — throws |
| m365 | 1. fetch + XHR + **WebSocket** capture (SignalR `\x1e`-separated frames), shape-based, not URL-restricted → 2. `substrate.office.com/m365Copilot/GetConversation` reusing captured page request headers, or MSAL tokens (observed `oauth2/v2.0/token` responses first, then AES-GCM-decrypted MSAL localStorage cache), each tried with both `fetch` and `GM_xmlhttpRequest` → 3. known-layout DOM → 4. late capture wait → 5. heuristic DOM | Yes, explicitly labelled |

The generic capture wrapper pattern to mirror:

```js
function installNetworkCapture() {
  const originalFetch = pageWin.fetch;
  if (typeof originalFetch !== 'function' || originalFetch.__cgptExportPatched) return;

  const patched = function (...args) {
    const promise = originalFetch.apply(this, args);
    return promise.then((response) => {
      try {
        const input = args[0];
        const url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : input?.url || '';
        // body 只能讀一次，一定要 clone，否則網站自己就讀不到了。
        if (response.ok && /\/backend-api\/(conversation|share)\//.test(url)) {
          response.clone().json().then(rememberPayload).catch(() => {});
        }
      } catch { /* 攔截失敗不能影響網站本身 */ }
      return response; // 一定要把原本的 response 還回去
    });
  };
  patched.__cgptExportPatched = true;
  pageWin.fetch = patched;
}
```

(m365's version also handles `input instanceof URL`, filters on `content-type: json` instead of URL, and records request headers. Its `installFetchCapture` is the most robust variant to copy.)

Plus the async-arrival guard, present in claude/copilot/m365:

```js
async function waitForCapture(ids, { timeout = 8_000, interval = 200 } = {}) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeout;
  for (;;) {
    const hit = pickCaptured(ids);
    if (hit) return hit;
    if (Date.now() >= deadline) return null;
    await delay(interval);
  }
}
```

When DOM scraping is used, m365 marks it in the output rather than hiding it:

```js
sourceLabel: String(hit.source || '').startsWith('dom-scrape')
  ? 'Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat（從畫面擷取，可能不完整）'
  : 'Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat',
```

and `resolveConversation` returns `source: 'dom-scrape (可能不完整)'` / `'dom-scrape (啟發式，可能不完整)'`, which also lands in the panel status text.

# 6. Avoiding scraping your own injected UI

Three mechanisms, all in m365 (the API-only scripts are immune because they never read the DOM):

1. The panel lives under a single element `document.getElementById(`${NS}-root`)` — a stable, namespaced handle.
2. Both DOM paths filter against it:
   ```js
   const ownRoot = document.getElementById(`${NS}-root`);
   // known layout:
   .filter((el) => !(ownRoot && ownRoot.contains(el)))
   // heuristic loop:
   for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('*')) {
     // 一定要排掉自己注入的 UI，否則會把自己的按鈕文字當成對話內容
     if (ownRoot && ownRoot.contains(el)) continue;
     …
   }
   ```
3. `htmlToMarkdown()` strips `button`, `[role="button"]`, `[aria-hidden="true"]` and site chrome on a **clone**, so neither the site's own action bars nor stray controls leak in and the live page is never mutated.

`CLAUDE.md` also calls this out as an untestable-by-screenshot bug class: *「寫 exporter 類腳本時，一定要用 `--menu` 把輸出印出來看——『注入的 UI 汙染自己的抓取結果』這種 bug 截圖看不出來。」*

# 7. `shared/` — full contents

Four files: `README.md`, `dom.js`, `chat-export.js`, `export-ui.js`. They are **not ES modules** — `@require`d files execute in the script's scope, so everything is a global function declaration.

### `shared/README.md` (67 lines)
Documents the three modules, then a "⚠️ 先考慮直接複製" section: `@require` costs are (1) updates don't propagate because the consuming script's `@version` doesn't change and managers cache `@require`s, (2) an extra network dependency on raw.githubusercontent.com. Rule of thumb: only move code to `shared/` when it appears in **three or more** scripts. `export-ui.js` deliberately calls **no GM API** — position persistence goes through an injected `storage` object — because `check-meta.mjs` only scans the script body to cross-check `@grant`. Also: `npm run preview` resolves `@require`s pointing at this repo from the working tree (so uncommitted `shared/` changes are testable), and `npm run check` errors on a repo-relative `@require` whose file doesn't exist.

### `shared/dom.js` (93 lines) — currently `@require`d by **nobody**; kept as an example/copy source
`waitForElement(selector, {timeout, root})`, `onUrlChange(callback)`, `debounce(fn, ms)`, `markOnce(element, key)`, `addFloatingButton({id, label, onClick, offset})`, `downloadText(filename, text, mime)`.

### `shared/chat-export.js` (207 lines) — the doc→Markdown layer, no DOM, no GM
Exports `fence`, `jsonFence`, `pad`, `toDate`, `formatUtc`, `localIso`, `yaml`, `mergeSections`, `sourcesBlock`, `handoffHeader`, `renderTranscript`, `filenameFor`, `downloadText`.

The doc contract (from the header comment) is the only interface between scripts:

```js
{
  source: 'chatgpt',            // frontmatter 的 source，也用在檔名前綴
  sourceLabel: 'ChatGPT',       // 給人看的名字（Agent Handoff 的抬頭用）
  title: '…',
  url: 'https://…',
  ids: { conversation_id: '…', share_id: '…' },  // 有什麼寫什麼，原樣進 frontmatter
  model: '',                    // 沒有就空字串
  createdAt: 1756100000 | '2026-08-23T12:34:14Z',
  sections: [{ role, model, time, body }],
}
```

Key functions:

```js
/** fence 要比內文裡最長的一串 backtick 還長，否則 code block 會被自己的內容截斷。 */
function fence(body, lang = '') {
  const text = String(body ?? '');
  const longest = (text.match(/`+/g) || []).reduce((max, run) => Math.max(max, run.length), 0);
  const ticks = '`'.repeat(Math.max(3, longest + 1));
  return `${ticks}${lang}\n${text.replace(/\n$/, '')}\n${ticks}`;
}

function mergeSections(sections) {           // 連續同 role 合併，避免一堆一行的區塊
  const merged = [];
  for (const section of sections) {
    const body = String(section.body ?? '').trim();
    if (!body) continue;
    const previous = merged[merged.length - 1];
    if (previous && previous.role === section.role) {
      previous.body += `\n\n${body}`;
      if (!previous.model) previous.model = section.model || '';
      continue;
    }
    merged.push({ role: section.role, model: section.model || '', time: section.time, body });
  }
  return merged;
}

function sourcesBlock(citations) {           // 去重後的 `**Sources**` 清單
  const seen = new Set();
  const lines = [];
  for (const citation of citations || []) {
    const url = citation?.url;
    if (!url || seen.has(url)) continue;
    seen.add(url);
    lines.push(`- [${citation.title || url}](${url})`);
  }
  return lines.length ? `**Sources**\n\n${lines.join('\n')}` : '';
}

function renderTranscript(doc, opts = {}) {  // opts: { handoff, includeThinking, includeTools, exporter }
  const sections = mergeSections(doc.sections || []);
  if (sections.length === 0) throw new Error('這個對話沒有可匯出的訊息。');

  const title = doc.title || `${doc.sourceLabel || doc.source} conversation`;
  const idLines = Object.entries(doc.ids || {})
    .filter(([, value]) => value)
    .map(([key, value]) => `${key}: ${yaml(value)}`);

  const frontMatter = [
    '---',
    `source: ${doc.source}`,
    `title: ${yaml(title)}`,
    `url: ${yaml(doc.url)}`,
    ...idLines,
    `model: ${yaml(doc.model || '')}`,
    `created_at: ${yaml(formatUtc(doc.createdAt))}`,
    `exported_at: ${yaml(localIso())}`,
    `messages: ${sections.length}`,
    `include_thinking: ${opts.includeThinking === true}`,
    `include_tools: ${opts.includeTools === true}`,
    `exporter: ${yaml(opts.exporter || '')}`,
    '---',
  ].join('\n');

  const body = sections
    .map((section) => {
      const label = [section.model, formatUtc(section.time)].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
      return `_**${section.role}${label ? ` (${label})` : ''}**_\n\n${section.body}`;
    })
    .join('\n\n---\n\n');

  const heading = opts.handoff ? handoffHeader(doc.sourceLabel || doc.source) : `# ${title}`;
  return `${frontMatter}\n\n${heading}\n\n<!-- Generated by ${opts.exporter} -->\n\n${body}\n`;
}

/** `<source>-<標題>-<YYYYMMDD-HHmm>.<ext>`，檔名不合法的字元一律拿掉。 */
function filenameFor(doc, extension) {
  const slug = String(doc.title || 'conversation')
    .replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, '-').slice(0, 60) || 'conversation';
  const now = new Date();
  const stamp = `${now.getFullYear()}${pad(now.getMonth() + 1)}${pad(now.getDate())}-` +
                `${pad(now.getHours())}${pad(now.getMinutes())}`;
  return `${doc.source}-${slug}-${stamp}.${extension}`;
}
```

`handoffHeader(label)` emits `# Prior <Label> Context` + four instruction bullets (treat decisions as existing project decisions, don't reopen settled design questions, preserve constraints, consult the conversation) + `## Conversation`.

`toDate()` accepts epoch seconds (`< 1e12` ⇒ ×1000), epoch ms, `Date`, or ISO string — so Gemini's timestamps in any of those forms will work unchanged.

### `shared/export-ui.js` (247 lines) — `createExportPanel(config)`
Config: `{ ns, buttonLabel, buttonTitle?, panelWidth = 230, actions[], toggles[]?, shareInput?, storage, onStatus? }`. Returns `{ mount, openPanel, setStatus, resetPosition }`.

Behaviour worth knowing when mirroring: root id is `${ns}-root`, panel id `${ns}-panel`; `mount()` is idempotent (`if (!document.body || document.getElementById(`${ns}-root`)) return;`); `placePanel()` flips the panel above/below and right/left based on available viewport space; `makeDraggable()` uses pointer events with a 4 px threshold so a shaky click still toggles the panel, saves `{left, top}` under storage key `'buttonPosition'`, and sets a `justDragged` flag that swallows the synthetic click after a drag; a `resize` listener re-clamps the button; the status line starts as `'就緒'`. All colours are inline (`#12181f` panel, `#3ba3ff` button, z-index `2147483647`).

# 8. `userscripts/_template/template.user.js`

78 lines. Placeholders `{{NAME}}`, `{{DESCRIPTION}}`, `{{MATCH}}`, `{{ICON}}`, `{{SLUG}}`; defaults `@version 0.1.0`, `@run-at document-idle`, `@grant none`, canonical `@updateURL`/`@downloadURL`. Body is an IIFE with `LOG_PREFIX`/`log`, an idempotent `run()`, local copies of `waitForElement()` and `onUrlChange()`, then:

```js
run();
onUrlChange(run);

// 用不到就刪掉，留著只是提醒有這個工具可用。
void waitForElement;
```

The exporters diverge substantially from this template (document-start, grants, `@require`), so scaffolding a Gemini script with `npm run new` and then replacing the body with the copilot script's structure is the intended workflow (`npm run new -- gemini-export-markdown "Gemini Export Markdown" "https://gemini.google.com/*" "…"`).

# 9. `scripts/lib/icon.mjs` — the data: URI icon

34 lines. Rationale in the header: favicon services 404 for domains without an icon, which Violentmonkey shows as a red "Error fetching resource!" on the script card; a remote icon also leaks browsing info and breaks offline.

```js
function hueFor(slug) {                      // deterministic hue per slug
  let hash = 0;
  for (const ch of slug) hash = (hash * 31 + ch.codePointAt(0)) % 360;
  return hash;
}

function initialsFor(slug) {                 // "page-title-tag" -> "PT", "hello" -> "HE"
  const words = slug.split('-').filter(Boolean);
  const letters = words.length >= 2 ? words[0][0] + words[1][0] : slug.slice(0, 2);
  return letters.toUpperCase();
}

export function iconFor(slug) {
  const hue = hueFor(slug);
  const initials = initialsFor(slug);
  const svg =
    `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 64 64">` +
    `<rect width="64" height="64" rx="14" fill="hsl(${hue} 62% 46%)"/>` +
    `<text x="32" y="33" fill="#fff" font-family="Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif"` +
    ` font-size="27" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle"` +
    ` dominant-baseline="central">${initials}</text>` +
    `</svg>`;
  return `data:image/svg+xml;base64,${Buffer.from(svg, 'utf8').toString('base64')}`;
}
```

Note the initials come from the **first two hyphen-separated words**, which is why `chatgpt-export-markdown`, `claude-export-markdown` and `copilot-export-markdown` all render "CE" (only the hue differs). A `gemini-export-markdown` slug would also be "GE". Generate it with `node -e "import('./scripts/lib/icon.mjs').then(m => console.log(m.iconFor('gemini-export-markdown')))"` or just let `npm run new` fill `{{ICON}}`.

# 10. `scripts/check-meta.mjs` — enforced rules

Run via `npm run check`; `npm run verify` = `check` + `index:check` (what CI runs).

**Errors (exit 1):**
- File must be `userscripts/<slug>/<slug>.user.js`.
- A `// ==UserScript== … // ==/UserScript==` block must exist.
- Required keys present: `REQUIRED = ['name', 'namespace', 'version', 'description', 'author', 'grant', 'run-at']` — `run-at` is required because TM defaults to `document-idle` and VM to `document-end`.
- At least one `@match` (preferred) or `@include`.
- `@updateURL` and `@downloadURL` both present and exactly `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daviddwlee84/Tampermonkey-Scripts/main/userscripts/<slug>/<slug>.user.js`.
- Every `GM_*` / `GM.*` used in the body (comments and string literals stripped first via `stripCommentsAndStrings`; `GM_info`/`GM.info` exempt) must have a matching `@grant`; `@grant none` alongside any GM usage is an error.
- A `@require` pointing into this repo must resolve to an existing file.

**Warnings:**
- `@version` not matching `^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$`.
- No `README.md` next to the script.
- `@require` outside this repo.
- `@icon` that isn't a `data:` URI.
- Any GM API outside `PORTABLE_GM`.
- Manager-specific keys: `MANAGER_SPECIFIC_KEYS = { sandbox: 'Tampermonkey', 'inject-into': 'Violentmonkey', 'exclude-match': 'Violentmonkey', antifeature: 'Tampermonkey / script hosts' }`.

**`PORTABLE_GM`** (APIs documented as supported by both Tampermonkey and Violentmonkey):

```js
GM_info, GM_cookie, GM_getValue, GM_getValues, GM_setValue, GM_setValues,
GM_deleteValue, GM_deleteValues, GM_listValues, GM_addValueChangeListener,
GM_removeValueChangeListener, GM_getResourceText, GM_getResourceURL,
GM_addElement, GM_addStyle, GM_openInTab, GM_registerMenuCommand,
GM_unregisterMenuCommand, GM_notification, GM_setClipboard,
GM_xmlhttpRequest, GM_download
```

`unsafeWindow` is not in the set but also never matches `KNOWN_GM = /\bGM[._]([A-Za-z]\w*)/g`, so granting it is silent. Every API the exporters use is inside `PORTABLE_GM`, so a correctly-written Gemini script should produce zero warnings.

# 11. README conventions (representative: `userscripts/chatgpt-export-markdown/README.md`, 98 lines)

Full text is quoted in my exploration above; the shape is:

1. `# <Name>` + a two-to-three-line 繁體中文 purpose statement ("目的是**貼給 coding agent**（Claude Code / Codex / Cursor…）當作前情提要").
2. Three bullets: `**生效網站**` (backticked match), `**安裝**：[點這裡安裝](<raw URL>)（需先裝好 Tampermonkey / Violentmonkey）`, `**原始碼**：[`<slug>.user.js`](./<slug>.user.js)`.
3. `## 它做了什麼` — a 4-row `| 動作 | 輸出 |` table (Copy Markdown / Copy Agent Handoff / Download .md / Download .json), then the two toggles, the drag-and-remember note plus `Reset button position`, then "同樣的動作在 manager 的選單裡也各有一個".
4. A usage snippet:
   ```bash
   pbpaste > /tmp/chat-context.md
   claude
   # > Read @/tmp/chat-context.md first. Treat the decisions there as project context.
   ```
5. `## 為什麼不是「抓 DOM 轉 Markdown」就好` (or `## 資料是從哪來的` in claude) — the design rationale with a numbered `| # | 來源 | 適用 |` table of the fallback chain and the explicit statement that failure is loud, not a DOM fallback.
6. `## 幾個處理過的細節` — bullets on citations, merging consecutive same-role messages, single-branch export, unknown types preserved as JSON.
7. `## 已知限制` — fragility of app internals with a link to `docs/06-sandbox-and-unsafewindow.md`, what was/wasn't verified end-to-end, image handling, and the note that `shared/` adds a raw.githubusercontent.com dependency.
8. `## 測試` — the exact `npm run preview` invocation, e.g.
   ```bash
   npm run preview -- chatgpt-export-markdown \
     "https://chatgpt.com/share/<id>" --menu "Copy Markdown" --wait 20000
   ```
   with the note that `--wait` can't be omitted (harness default is 300 ms).

Root `README.md` has a `<!-- BEGIN SCRIPT INDEX -->` / `<!-- END SCRIPT INDEX -->` table regenerated only by `npm run index` (`scripts/build-index.mjs`) — never edit it by hand.

# 12. Checklist implied for a new `gemini-export-markdown`

- Scaffold with `npm run new -- gemini-export-markdown "Gemini Export Markdown" "https://gemini.google.com/*" "…"`, then replace the body.
- Header: `@run-at document-start`, grants `unsafeWindow, GM_registerMenuCommand, GM_setClipboard, GM_setValue, GM_getValue` (+ `GM_deleteValue, GM_openInTab` if doing the share-tab handoff), both `shared/` `@require`s, both URL keys, generated data: icon, and the `/* global … */` line.
- Copy the copilot script wholesale as the closest template if Gemini's payload shape is unknown (shape-based `findMessageList` + fetch **and** XHR capture); copy chatgpt's if you can pin an exact endpoint/shape; only borrow m365's `nodeToMarkdown`/`htmlToMarkdown`/`ownRoot` filtering if a DOM fallback proves necessary, and label it in `sourceLabel`.
- Emit the standard doc shape with `source: 'gemini'`, `sourceLabel: 'Gemini'` and let `renderTranscript` do the rest.
- Bump `@version`, run `npm run check`, `npm run index`, and test with `npm run preview -- gemini-export-markdown "<url>" --menu "Copy Markdown" --wait 20000` (the `--menu` run is what catches self-UI contamination).

Lauren (Potato / pstack) 的精選 Skills\n\n* **`unslop`（去 AI 油膩感 / 提高可讀性）** [[05:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0oXOOlqVu5M&t=313)]\n  * **作用**：移除 LLM 常見的廢話、空泛讚美詞（如 pivotal moment、evolving landscape 等）以及過度使用的破折號（em-dashes），讓 Agent 回答精簡、具體且口語化。\n  * Theo 認為這是改變體驗最大的 Skill，大幅提升了閱讀 Agent 產出結果的意願 [[12:40](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0oXOOlqVu5M&t=760)]。\n* **`arena`（平行競爭與綜合解法）** [[32:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0oXOOlqVu5M&t=1920)]\n  * 針對同一個任務同時平行生成多個解決方案，評估各候選方案後截取各家優點合併為最佳實作。\n* **`blast radius`（爆炸半徑 / 影響範圍分析）** [[33:29](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0oXOOlqVu5M&t=2009)]\n  * 在送出修改前，主動檢查該代碼變更可能會破壞專案中其他哪些地方，並透過執行代碼來驗證核心假設。\n* **`show me your work`（決策追蹤日誌）** [[34:21](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0oXOOlqVu5M&t=2061)]\n  * 讓長時間自主運行的 Agent 將每一步決策與理由記錄成單行的 TSV 日誌，方便人類工程師審查與復盤。\n\n---\n\n#### 3. Matt Pocock 的精選 Skills\n\n* **`grill me` / `grill with docs`（嚴格拷問與架構釐清）** [[15:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0oXOOlqVu5M&t=906)]\n  * **作用**：Agent 會針對專案設計或需求向工程師發起連珠炮般的「拷問式訪談」，逐層釐清邊界條件、目標客群與架構決策 [[17:14](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0oXOOlqVu5M&t=1034)]。\n  * 適用於在開始動工寫代碼前，先將模糊的想法整理成清晰的規格說明。\n* **`diagnosing bugs`（錯誤排查）** [[14:40](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0oXOOlqVu5M&t=880)]\n  * 模型自動調用的 Skill，引導 Agent 更精準地找出 Bug 根因，而非只給出表面修補。\n* **`wizard`（引導人類執行手動步驟）** [[21:29](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0oXOOlqVu5M&t=1289)]\n  * 當 Agent 遇到沒有權限處理的任務（如需要手動認證、後台面板設定或 `sudo` 權限）時，會引導人類逐步完成操作。\n* **`writing for agents`（撰寫給 Agent 看的文件）** [[28:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0oXOOlqVu5M&t=1731)]\n  * 指導 Agent 如何為其他子 Agent 或協同模型撰寫清晰、低歧義的 Markdown 指令。\n\n---\n\n### 總結建議 [[36:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0oXOOlqVu5M&t=2164)]\n1. **先從單一痛點切入**：例如先嘗試安裝 `unslop` 或 `grill me`，體驗 Agent 行為的改變。\n2. **善用集中式管理**：Theo 建議建立統一的 Skills 倉庫（如他的 `fleet` 倉庫）來同步多台開發機器的 Skills。\n3. **不怕修改 Markdown**：現代 AI 輔助開發的核心正是這些 Markdown 規則與環境設定，根據團隊與個人習慣持續迭代才能發揮最大效益。\nhttp://googleusercontent.com/youtube_content/1 *YouTube 视频观看记录会存储在你的 YouTube 历史记录中，YouTube 会根据其 [《服务条款》](https://www.youtube.com/static?template=terms) 存储和使用你的数据*\n\n\nhttp://googleusercontent.com/youtube_content/2 *YouTube 视频观看记录会存储在你的 YouTube 历史记录中，YouTube 会根据其 [《服务条款》](https://www.youtube.com/static?template=terms) 存储和使用你的数据*\n\n"

```text
// bypassCSP mirrors a real manager: it injects the script outside the page's
// Content-Security-Policy. Without it, sites with a nonce-based CSP or Trusted
// Types (claude.ai, copilot.microsoft.com) reject the injection outright.
const page = await browser.newPage({
  viewport: { width: 1280, height: 800 },
  bypassCSP: true,
});

const logs = [];
page.on('console', (msg) => logs.push(`  [${msg.type()}] ${msg.text()}`));
page.on('pageerror', (err) => logs.push(`  [pageerror] ${err.message}`));

/**
 * Resolve one @require URL to its source. URLs pointing at this repo are read
 * from the working tree, so `npm run preview` tests uncommitted shared/ code
 * instead of whatever is on main.
 */
async function loadRequire(requireUrl) {
  if (requireUrl.startsWith(`${RAW_BASE}/`)) {
    const relPath = requireUrl.slice(RAW_BASE.length + 1);
    return { source: readFileSync(join(REPO_ROOT, relPath), 'utf8'), from: `local ${relPath}` };
  }
  const res = await fetch(requireUrl);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`${requireUrl} -> HTTP ${res.status}`);
  return { source: await res.text(), from: `remote ${requireUrl}` };
}

console.log(`→ ${url}`);
await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });

// @run-at document-idle roughly corresponds to after load + a beat.
await page.addScriptTag({ content: GM_SHIM });

// A manager evaluates every @require in the script's scope before the script
// itself. Do the same, or a script built on shared/ dies on the first call.
for (const requireUrl of script.meta.require ?? []) {
  let loaded;
  try {
    loaded = await loadRequire(requireUrl);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`@require failed: ${err.message}`);
    await browser.close();
    process.exit(1);
  }
  await page.addScriptTag({ content: loaded.source });
  console.log(`@require       : ${loaded.from}`);
}

await page.addScriptTag({ content: readFileSync(script.file, 'utf8') });
await page.waitForTimeout(600);

// Optionally drive the script the way a user would, then re-screenshot.
const clickSelector = value('--click');
if (clickSelector) {
  await page.click(clickSelector);
  await page.waitForTimeout(300);
  console.log(`clicked        : ${clickSelector}`);
```

````markdown
# gemini-export-markdown

## Context

這個 repo 已經有四支 `*-export-markdown` 腳本（ChatGPT / Claude / Copilot / M365 Copilot），
目的都一樣：把整段對話轉成 Markdown，貼給 coding agent 當前情提要。
現在要補上 Gemini（<https://gemini.google.com/>）。

使用者指出 share page 與聊天進行中的界面長得不一樣，需要特別處理 —— 這點成立，
但**主要差異其實不在 DOM，而在資料從哪個 RPC 來**。以下是實測（Playwright + curl 打
`https://share.gemini.google/S91ylHxDs2Ug`）確認過的事實：

| 事實 | 意義 |
|---|---|
| `share.gemini.google/<code>` 會 302 到 `gemini.google.com/share/<id>` | `@match` 只要 `https://gemini.google.com/*`，短網址網域不用列 |
| 初始 HTML 完全沒有對話內容（只有 Angular 殼 `<chat-app-orchestrator>`） | 沒有 `__NEXT_DATA__` 之類的東西可撈，一定要走 RPC 或 DOM |
| 資料來自 `POST /_/BardChatUi/data/batchexecute`，body 是 `)]}'` + 長度前綴 + `[["wrb.fr","<rpcid>","<JSON string>"]]` | 攔截點就是這個 URL |
| **payload 裡的 assistant 內容是原始 Markdown**，不是 HTML | API 路徑完全不需要 HTML→Markdown 轉換，品質遠勝掃 DOM |
| share 用 `rpcids=ujx1Bf`，body 是 `f.req=[[["ujx1Bf","[null,\"<shareId>\",[4]]",null,"generic"]]]`，**匿名 curl 直接重放成功**（無 cookie、無 `at` token） | share 頁可以自己發請求，不必靠攔截 |
| 匿名 share 頁的 `WIZ_global_data` 沒有 `SNlM0e`（`at` token），但有 `cfb2h`（`bl`）與 `FdrFJe`（`f.sid`） | 自發請求的參數湊得出來 |
| `npm run preview` 是在 `domcontentloaded` **之後**才注入腳本 | `@run-at document-start` 的攔截層在 preview 裡永遠不會生效，只有 self-fetch 與 DOM 路徑測得到 |

實測解出來的 payload 結構（`inner = JSON.parse(row[2])`）：

```text
inner[0][1]              → turns 陣列
  turn[0]                → ["c_<conversationId>", "r_<responseId>"]
  turn[2][0][0]          → 使用者這輪的文字
  turn[3][0]             → 候選草稿陣列，每個是 ["rc_<id>", ["<markdown>"], …]
  turn[3][4] / turn[3][5]→ 工具呼叫（youtube_tool …）
  turn[3][0][0][12]      → structured content（畫面渲染用的鏡像，匯出不需要）
  turn[3][0][0][30]      → 附件／引用來源（YouTube 影片 metadata 等）
inner[0][2]              → [true, "<title>", …, [2,"<modelId>","Flash"], true]
inner[0][3]              → "<shareId>"
inner[0][4]              → [<epoch seconds>, <nanos>]
```

決定：**API 優先，全部失敗才退回掃 DOM 並在輸出裡標明「可能不完整」**（比照
`m365-copilot-export-markdown`）；toggles 用 `includeThinking` / `includeTools`，
另加第三個 `includeDrafts` 匯出同一輪的其他候選草稿。

## 檔案

新增：

- `userscripts/gemini-export-markdown/gemini-export-markdown.user.js`
- `userscripts/gemini-export-markdown/README.md`

修改：

- `README.md`（只透過 `npm run index` 重產腳本清單表格）

`shared/chat-export.js` 與 `shared/export-ui.js` 直接 `@require` 沿用，**不要改動**
（改了會影響已上線的四支腳本，而且 manager 會 cache `@require`）。

## 建立方式

```bash
npm run new -- gemini-export-markdown "Gemini Export Markdown" "https://gemini.google.com/*" \
  "把整段 Gemini 對話匯成 Markdown（含 share 頁），貼給 coding agent 用"
```

再把 body 換掉。scaffolder 會填好 `@updateURL` / `@downloadURL` 與
`scripts/lib/icon.mjs` 產生的 data: URI icon。

## Metadata

比照 `copilot-export-markdown`：

```js
// @match        https://gemini.google.com/*
// @run-at       document-start
// @grant        unsafeWindow
// @grant        GM_registerMenuCommand
// @grant        GM_setClipboard
// @grant        GM_setValue
// @grant        GM_getValue
// @grant        GM_deleteValue
// @grant        GM_openInTab
// @require      …/shared/chat-export.js
// @require      …/shared/export-ui.js
```

`document-start` 是必要的：`fetch` / `XHR` 要在 Angular 發出第一個 batchexecute 之前就換掉。
`unsafeWindow` 是因為有任何 `@grant` 就會被 sandbox，patch `window.fetch` 打不到頁面。
`GM_openInTab` / `GM_deleteValue` 供 share URL 換頁 handoff（同 claude / copilot）。
`@grant` 全在 `check-meta.mjs` 的 `PORTABLE_GM` 裡，不會有 warning。

`page-title-tag` 已經 match `https://gemini.google.com/*`，兩支共存沒問題。

## 程式結構

沿用四支腳本共通的骨架與註解分節，常數：

```js
const VERSION = '0.1.0';
const NS = 'gemini-export-md';
const EXPORTER = `gemini-export-markdown v${VERSION}`;
const BATCH_RE = /\/_\/BardChatUi\/data\/batchexecute/;
const SHARE_RPC = 'ujx1Bf';
```

### 1. batchexecute 解析（本腳本最核心的新東西）

```js
/** batchexecute 回應是 `)]}'` + 「長度行 + JSON」重複。長度是位元組數不是字元數，
 *  中文會對不上，所以不要照長度切 —— 直接掃平衡括號比較穩。 */
function parseBatchExecute(body) { … }   // → 每個 ["wrb.fr", rpcid, payloadString] 的 JSON.parse 結果
```

實作要點（都是實測踩到的）：

- 先 `body.replace(/^\)\]\}'\s*/, '')`。
- 用 quote/escape-aware 的括號平衡掃描找出每個 top-level `[…]`，逐個 `JSON.parse`，
  失敗就跳過（長度行本身會 parse 失敗，正常）。
- 取 `row[0] === 'wrb.fr' && typeof row[2] === 'string'` 的 `JSON.parse(row[2])`。

### 2. Turn 抽取：認 id 前綴，不要寫死索引

比照 `copilot-export-markdown` 的 `findMessageList()` 精神 —— 深掃 + shape 判斷，
但錨點換成 Gemini 那組語意穩定的 id 前綴（`c_` / `r_` / `rc_`），因為純索引路徑
（`[0][1][0][3][0][0][1][0]`）一改版就死：

```js
const isTurn = (v) =>
  Array.isArray(v) && Array.isArray(v[0]) &&
  /^c_/.test(v[0][0] || '') && /^r_/.test(v[0][1] || '');

const isDraft = (v) =>
  Array.isArray(v) && /^rc_/.test(v[0] || '') &&
  Array.isArray(v[1]) && typeof v[1][0] === 'string';
```

- `collectTurns(payload)`：深掃（限深度，帶 `seen` Set 防環）收集所有 `isTurn` 節點，
  以 `turn[0][1]`（`r_…`）去重。
- 每個 turn：
  - user：`turn[2][0][0]`，取不到就在 `turn[2]` 裡找第一個非空字串。
  - assistant：在 `turn[3]` 裡深掃 `isDraft`，第一個是畫面顯示的那版；
    `includeDrafts` 打開時其餘的接在後面，加 `**Draft 2**` 之類的小標。
  - thinking（`includeThinking`）：payload 若有 thinking 字串就帶上；
    **這份 share 樣本沒有 thinking，所以要寫成「找不到就靜靜略過」而不是丟錯**。
  - tools / sources（`includeTools`）：`turn[3][4]` / `turn[3][5]` 的工具名稱，
    以及 `turn[3][0][0][30]` 底下的附件 metadata，整理成 `{title, url}` 丟給
    `shared/chat-export.js` 的 `sourcesBlock()`。
  - **不要**碰 `turn[3][0][0][12]`（structured content）—— 那是渲染鏡像，會重複內文。
- 未知型態不要靜默丟掉：照 chatgpt 的慣例，退回 `jsonFence(...)` 保留原始資料。

### 3. 來源優先序（`resolveConversation`）

| # | 來源 | 說明 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 網路攔截 | `document-start` patch `fetch` + `XMLHttpRequest`，命中 `BATCH_RE` 就把 response 文字丟給 `parseBatchExecute` 存起來。**一定要 `response.clone()`**，body 只能讀一次。patch 上掛 `__geminiExportPatched` 保證 idempotent。 |
| 2 | self-fetch（share 頁）| `/share/<id>` 時自己 POST `rpcids=ujx1Bf`，`f.req=[[["ujx1Bf","[null,\"<shareId>\",[4]]",null,"generic"]]]`，headers 只需 `content-type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded;charset=UTF-8` 與 `x-same-domain: 1`。`bl` 讀 `WIZ_global_data.cfb2h`、`f.sid` 讀 `FdrFJe`（讀不到就從攔到的 request URL 抄，再不行就省略）。**這是 preview 唯一測得到的 API 路徑。** |
| 3 | 等攔截 | 比照 copilot 的 `waitForCapture(ids, { timeout: 8000, interval: 200 })`，處理 RPC 比使用者按按鈕晚回來的情況。 |
| 4 | 掃 DOM（標明可能不完整）| 見下節。 |

`app` 頁沒有可靠的自發請求路徑（載入歷史的 rpcid 只能從攔截學到，猜不得），
所以 app 頁的保底就是第 4 條。

### 4. DOM 退路：share 與 app 兩套版面

實測 selector（share 頁已驗；app 頁用同一組內層節點，只有外層容器不同）：

```js
const LAYOUTS = [
  { name: 'share', turn: 'share-turn-viewer' },                     // /share/<id>
  { name: 'app',   turn: '.conversation-container, user-query' },   // /app/<id>
];
const USER_SEL = 'user-query-content .query-content';
const MODEL_SEL = 'message-content .markdown, message-content .markdown-main-panel';
```

- 先試 `share-turn-viewer`（每個節點內含一組 user + response），沒有再退 app 版面。
- **`.cdk-visually-hidden` 一定要剔掉**：`.query-content` 裡有一個
  `<h5 class="cdk-visually-hidden">You said …</h5>` 把使用者文字整段重複了一次，
  不剔會出現兩份。
- HTML→Markdown 直接搬 `m365-copilot-export-markdown.user.js` 的
  `nodeToMarkdown(node, depth)` / `htmlToMarkdown(el)`（約 130 行，repo 裡唯一的轉換器；
  `shared/` 刻意不放 DOM 相關東西，照 `shared/README.md` 的「三支以上才抽共用」規則，
  這是第二支，複製而不是抽共用）。噪音 selector 換成 Gemini 的：

  ```js
  const DOM_NOISE_SELECTOR = [
    '.cdk-visually-hidden',        // "You said" 螢幕閱讀器標籤，會讓提問重複兩次
    'mat-icon', 'gem-icon', 'gem-icon-button',
    'button', '[role="button"]', '[aria-hidden="true"]',
    '.code-block-decoration',      // code block 的語言列 + 複製/下載鈕
    'script', 'style', 'svg',
  ].join(', ');
  ```

- `nodeToMarkdown` 要多認兩個 Gemini custom element：`response-element` 與 `link-block`
  是純包裝（裡面就是 `<a>`），落到 `default:` 遞迴 children 即可，不用特判；
  但 `code-block` 要在剝掉 `.code-block-decoration` 之後，語言標記從那顆 header 的
  文字取（Gemini 不用 `language-xxx` class）。
- **排掉自己注入的 UI**：`const ownRoot = document.getElementById(`${NS}-root`)`，
  兩條 DOM 路徑都要 `.filter((el) => !(ownRoot && ownRoot.contains(el)))`。
  這是 CLAUDE.md 點名截圖看不出來的 bug 類型。
- 走到這條時 `sourceLabel` 要寫成 `'Gemini（從畫面擷取，可能不完整）'`，
  `resolveConversation` 回 `source: 'dom-scrape (可能不完整)'`，讓面板狀態列也看得到。

### 5. normalize → shared 層

輸出 `shared/chat-export.js` 的 doc 契約，其餘（frontmatter、Agent Handoff 標頭、
連續同 role 合併、檔名）都由 `renderTranscript()` / `filenameFor()` 處理：

```js
{
  source: 'gemini',
  sourceLabel: 'Gemini',
  title: inner[0][2][1] || 'Gemini conversation',
  url: location.href,
  ids: { conversation_id: 'c_…', share_id: inner[0][3] || '' },
  model: inner[0][2][7]?.[2] || '',      // 例："Flash"
  createdAt: inner[0][4]?.[0],           // epoch 秒，toDate() 直接吃
  sections: [{ role: 'User' | 'Assistant', model, time, body }],
}
```

### 6. UI 與動作

`ACTIONS` / `createExportPanel` / `registerMenu` 照抄 copilot，只改三處：

- `buttonLabel: '⇩ Export MD'`（不變）
- `toggles` 多第三個：`{ label: '含其他候選草稿', get/set → includeDrafts }`，
  `SETTINGS_KEYS = ['includeThinking', 'includeTools', 'includeDrafts']`
- `shareInput.onSubmit = exportFromShareUrl`：`shareIdFromUrl()` 要同時吃
  `gemini.google.com/share/<id>` 與 `share.gemini.google/<code>`；後者無法在本地解析成
  真 id，走 `GM_openInTab` + `PENDING_KEY` 換頁 handoff（同 claude / copilot），
  新分頁載完由 `consumePending()` 自動複製。

`GM_registerMenuCommand` 不要加 `accessKey`（TM 限定）。

### 7. SPA / 啟動

照抄四支共通的 bootstrap：`installNetworkCapture()` → `registerMenu()` →
DOM ready 後 `start()`（`ui.mount()` + `consumePending()` + 用 `MutationObserver`
偵測 `location.href` 變化後重新 `ui.mount()`）。Gemini 換對話不 reload，
但抓資料不依賴 DOM 狀態，所以只要保證 UI 還在即可。

## README

比照 `userscripts/chatgpt-export-markdown/README.md` 的七節結構，Gemini 版要額外寫清楚：

- share 頁（`/share/<id>`）與 app 頁（`/app/<id>`）的資料來源差異，以及為什麼
  share 頁可以自發請求、app 頁不行
- payload 給的是原始 Markdown，所以 API 路徑的輸出比掃 DOM 準
- 掃 DOM 這條會在 frontmatter 的 `title` 與面板狀態列標明「可能不完整」
- `## 測試` 節放下面那行 preview 指令，並註明 preview 測不到攔截層

## 驗證

```bash
npm run check                 # metadata / grant 交叉比對
npm run index                 # 重產根 README 的腳本清單表格
npm run verify                # = check + index:check，等同 CI

# preview：share 頁走 self-fetch 路徑，--menu 把輸出印出來（CLAUDE.md 要求）
npm run preview -- gemini-export-markdown \
  "https://gemini.google.com/share/95f50d8e5390" --menu "Copy Markdown" --wait 20000
```

preview 通過的判準（不是看截圖，是看印出來的剪貼簿內容）：

1. frontmatter 有 `source: gemini`、`title: Theo 影片：AI Agent Skills 實測總結`、
   `model: Flash`、`share_id: 95f50d8e5390`、`messages: 2`
2. 使用者那輪是 `總結 https://youtu.be/0oXOOlqVu5M?is=DlFiMAP-nzOiYESR`，**只出現一次**
   （出現兩次＝走到 DOM 路徑而且沒剔掉 `.cdk-visually-hidden`）
3. assistant 那輪含 `### 核心精華與重點整理`、`* **\`unslop\`（去 AI 油膩感…`、

   —— 這些是 payload 的原始 Markdown，掃 DOM 生出來的長不一樣，可用來確認走的是哪條路

   注入 UI 或站方 chrome 的字串
````

## Approved Plan:
# gemini-export-markdown

## Context

這個 repo 已經有四支 `*-export-markdown` 腳本（ChatGPT / Claude / Copilot / M365 Copilot），
目的都一樣：把整段對話轉成 Markdown，貼給 coding agent 當前情提要。
現在要補上 Gemini（<https://gemini.google.com/>）。

使用者指出 share page 與聊天進行中的界面長得不一樣，需要特別處理 —— 這點成立，
但**主要差異其實不在 DOM，而在資料從哪個 RPC 來**。以下是實測（Playwright + curl 打
`https://share.gemini.google/S91ylHxDs2Ug`）確認過的事實：

| 事實 | 意義 |
|---|---|
| `share.gemini.google/<code>` 會 302 到 `gemini.google.com/share/<id>` | `@match` 只要 `https://gemini.google.com/*`，短網址網域不用列 |
| 初始 HTML 完全沒有對話內容（只有 Angular 殼 `<chat-app-orchestrator>`） | 沒有 `__NEXT_DATA__` 之類的東西可撈，一定要走 RPC 或 DOM |
| 資料來自 `POST /_/BardChatUi/data/batchexecute`，body 是 `)]}'` + 長度前綴 + `[["wrb.fr","<rpcid>","<JSON string>"]]` | 攔截點就是這個 URL |
| **payload 裡的 assistant 內容是原始 Markdown**，不是 HTML | API 路徑完全不需要 HTML→Markdown 轉換，品質遠勝掃 DOM |
| share 用 `rpcids=ujx1Bf`，body 是 `f.req=[[["ujx1Bf","[null,\"<shareId>\",[4]]",null,"generic"]]]`，**匿名 curl 直接重放成功**（無 cookie、無 `at` token） | share 頁可以自己發請求，不必靠攔截 |
| 匿名 share 頁的 `WIZ_global_data` 沒有 `SNlM0e`（`at` token），但有 `cfb2h`（`bl`）與 `FdrFJe`（`f.sid`） | 自發請求的參數湊得出來 |
| `npm run preview` 是在 `domcontentloaded` **之後**才注入腳本 | `@run-at document-start` 的攔截層在 preview 裡永遠不會生效，只有 self-fetch 與 DOM 路徑測得到 |

實測解出來的 payload 結構（`inner = JSON.parse(row[2])`）：

```text
inner[0][1]              → turns 陣列
  turn[0]                → ["c_<conversationId>", "r_<responseId>"]
  turn[2][0][0]          → 使用者這輪的文字
  turn[3][0]             → 候選草稿陣列，每個是 ["rc_<id>", ["<markdown>"], …]
  turn[3][4] / turn[3][5]→ 工具呼叫（youtube_tool …）
  turn[3][0][0][12]      → structured content（畫面渲染用的鏡像，匯出不需要）
  turn[3][0][0][30]      → 附件／引用來源（YouTube 影片 metadata 等）
inner[0][2]              → [true, "<title>", …, [2,"<modelId>","Flash"], true]
inner[0][3]              → "<shareId>"
inner[0][4]              → [<epoch seconds>, <nanos>]
```

決定：**API 優先，全部失敗才退回掃 DOM 並在輸出裡標明「可能不完整」**（比照
`m365-copilot-export-markdown`）；toggles 用 `includeThinking` / `includeTools`，
另加第三個 `includeDrafts` 匯出同一輪的其他候選草稿。

## 檔案

新增：

- `userscripts/gemini-export-markdown/gemini-export-markdown.user.js`
- `userscripts/gemini-export-markdown/README.md`

修改：

- `README.md`（只透過 `npm run index` 重產腳本清單表格）

`shared/chat-export.js` 與 `shared/export-ui.js` 直接 `@require` 沿用，**不要改動**
（改了會影響已上線的四支腳本，而且 manager 會 cache `@require`）。

## 建立方式

```bash
npm run new -- gemini-export-markdown "Gemini Export Markdown" "https://gemini.google.com/*" \
  "把整段 Gemini 對話匯成 Markdown（含 share 頁），貼給 coding agent 用"
```

再把 body 換掉。scaffolder 會填好 `@updateURL` / `@downloadURL` 與
`scripts/lib/icon.mjs` 產生的 data: URI icon。

## Metadata

比照 `copilot-export-markdown`：

```js
// @match        https://gemini.google.com/*
// @run-at       document-start
// @grant        unsafeWindow
// @grant        GM_registerMenuCommand
// @grant        GM_setClipboard
// @grant        GM_setValue
// @grant        GM_getValue
// @grant        GM_deleteValue
// @grant        GM_openInTab
// @require      …/shared/chat-export.js
// @require      …/shared/export-ui.js
```

`document-start` 是必要的：`fetch` / `XHR` 要在 Angular 發出第一個 batchexecute 之前就換掉。
`unsafeWindow` 是因為有任何 `@grant` 就會被 sandbox，patch `window.fetch` 打不到頁面。
`GM_openInTab` / `GM_deleteValue` 供 share URL 換頁 handoff（同 claude / copilot）。
`@grant` 全在 `check-meta.mjs` 的 `PORTABLE_GM` 裡，不會有 warning。

`page-title-tag` 已經 match `https://gemini.google.com/*`，兩支共存沒問題。

## 程式結構

沿用四支腳本共通的骨架與註解分節，常數：

```js
const VERSION = '0.1.0';
const NS = 'gemini-export-md';
const EXPORTER = `gemini-export-markdown v${VERSION}`;
const BATCH_RE = /\/_\/BardChatUi\/data\/batchexecute/;
const SHARE_RPC = 'ujx1Bf';
```

### 1. batchexecute 解析（本腳本最核心的新東西）

```js
/** batchexecute 回應是 `)]}'` + 「長度行 + JSON」重複。長度是位元組數不是字元數，
 *  中文會對不上，所以不要照長度切 —— 直接掃平衡括號比較穩。 */
function parseBatchExecute(body) { … }   // → 每個 ["wrb.fr", rpcid, payloadString] 的 JSON.parse 結果
```

實作要點（都是實測踩到的）：

- 先 `body.replace(/^\)\]\}'\s*/, '')`。
- 用 quote/escape-aware 的括號平衡掃描找出每個 top-level `[…]`，逐個 `JSON.parse`，
  失敗就跳過（長度行本身會 parse 失敗，正常）。
- 取 `row[0] === 'wrb.fr' && typeof row[2] === 'string'` 的 `JSON.parse(row[2])`。

### 2. Turn 抽取：認 id 前綴，不要寫死索引

比照 `copilot-export-markdown` 的 `findMessageList()` 精神 —— 深掃 + shape 判斷，
但錨點換成 Gemini 那組語意穩定的 id 前綴（`c_` / `r_` / `rc_`），因為純索引路徑
（`[0][1][0][3][0][0][1][0]`）一改版就死：

```js
const isTurn = (v) =>
  Array.isArray(v) && Array.isArray(v[0]) &&
  /^c_/.test(v[0][0] || '') && /^r_/.test(v[0][1] || '');

const isDraft = (v) =>
  Array.isArray(v) && /^rc_/.test(v[0] || '') &&
  Array.isArray(v[1]) && typeof v[1][0] === 'string';
```

- `collectTurns(payload)`：深掃（限深度，帶 `seen` Set 防環）收集所有 `isTurn` 節點，
  以 `turn[0][1]`（`r_…`）去重。
- 每個 turn：
  - user：`turn[2][0][0]`，取不到就在 `turn[2]` 裡找第一個非空字串。
  - assistant：在 `turn[3]` 裡深掃 `isDraft`，第一個是畫面顯示的那版；
    `includeDrafts` 打開時其餘的接在後面，加 `**Draft 2**` 之類的小標。
  - thinking（`includeThinking`）：payload 若有 thinking 字串就帶上；
    **這份 share 樣本沒有 thinking，所以要寫成「找不到就靜靜略過」而不是丟錯**。
  - tools / sources（`includeTools`）：`turn[3][4]` / `turn[3][5]` 的工具名稱，
    以及 `turn[3][0][0][30]` 底下的附件 metadata，整理成 `{title, url}` 丟給
    `shared/chat-export.js` 的 `sourcesBlock()`。
  - **不要**碰 `turn[3][0][0][12]`（structured content）—— 那是渲染鏡像，會重複內文。
- 未知型態不要靜默丟掉：照 chatgpt 的慣例，退回 `jsonFence(...)` 保留原始資料。

### 3. 來源優先序（`resolveConversation`）

| # | 來源 | 說明 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 網路攔截 | `document-start` patch `fetch` + `XMLHttpRequest`，命中 `BATCH_RE` 就把 response 文字丟給 `parseBatchExecute` 存起來。**一定要 `response.clone()`**，body 只能讀一次。patch 上掛 `__geminiExportPatched` 保證 idempotent。 |
| 2 | self-fetch（share 頁）| `/share/<id>` 時自己 POST `rpcids=ujx1Bf`，`f.req=[[["ujx1Bf","[null,\"<shareId>\",[4]]",null,"generic"]]]`，headers 只需 `content-type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded;charset=UTF-8` 與 `x-same-domain: 1`。`bl` 讀 `WIZ_global_data.cfb2h`、`f.sid` 讀 `FdrFJe`（讀不到就從攔到的 request URL 抄，再不行就省略）。**這是 preview 唯一測得到的 API 路徑。** |
| 3 | 等攔截 | 比照 copilot 的 `waitForCapture(ids, { timeout: 8000, interval: 200 })`，處理 RPC 比使用者按按鈕晚回來的情況。 |
| 4 | 掃 DOM（標明可能不完整）| 見下節。 |

`app` 頁沒有可靠的自發請求路徑（載入歷史的 rpcid 只能從攔截學到，猜不得），
所以 app 頁的保底就是第 4 條。

### 4. DOM 退路：share 與 app 兩套版面

實測 selector（share 頁已驗；app 頁用同一組內層節點，只有外層容器不同）：

```js
const LAYOUTS = [
  { name: 'share', turn: 'share-turn-viewer' },                     // /share/<id>
  { name: 'app',   turn: '.conversation-container, user-query' },   // /app/<id>
];
const USER_SEL = 'user-query-content .query-content';
const MODEL_SEL = 'message-content .markdown, message-content .markdown-main-panel';
```

- 先試 `share-turn-viewer`（每個節點內含一組 user + response），沒有再退 app 版面。
- **`.cdk-visually-hidden` 一定要剔掉**：`.query-content` 裡有一個
  `<h5 class="cdk-visually-hidden">You said …</h5>` 把使用者文字整段重複了一次，
  不剔會出現兩份。
- HTML→Markdown 直接搬 `m365-copilot-export-markdown.user.js` 的
  `nodeToMarkdown(node, depth)` / `htmlToMarkdown(el)`（約 130 行，repo 裡唯一的轉換器；
  `shared/` 刻意不放 DOM 相關東西，照 `shared/README.md` 的「三支以上才抽共用」規則，
  這是第二支，複製而不是抽共用）。噪音 selector 換成 Gemini 的：

  ```js
  const DOM_NOISE_SELECTOR = [
    '.cdk-visually-hidden',        // "You said" 螢幕閱讀器標籤，會讓提問重複兩次
    'mat-icon', 'gem-icon', 'gem-icon-button',
    'button', '[role="button"]', '[aria-hidden="true"]',
    '.code-block-decoration',      // code block 的語言列 + 複製/下載鈕
    'script', 'style', 'svg',
  ].join(', ');
  ```

- `nodeToMarkdown` 要多認兩個 Gemini custom element：`response-element` 與 `link-block`
  是純包裝（裡面就是 `<a>`），落到 `default:` 遞迴 children 即可，不用特判；
  但 `code-block` 要在剝掉 `.code-block-decoration` 之後，語言標記從那顆 header 的
  文字取（Gemini 不用 `language-xxx` class）。
- **排掉自己注入的 UI**：`const ownRoot = document.getElementById(`${NS}-root`)`，
  兩條 DOM 路徑都要 `.filter((el) => !(ownRoot && ownRoot.contains(el)))`。
  這是 CLAUDE.md 點名截圖看不出來的 bug 類型。
- 走到這條時 `sourceLabel` 要寫成 `'Gemini（從畫面擷取，可能不完整）'`，
  `resolveConversation` 回 `source: 'dom-scrape (可能不完整)'`，讓面板狀態列也看得到。

### 5. normalize → shared 層

輸出 `shared/chat-export.js` 的 doc 契約，其餘（frontmatter、Agent Handoff 標頭、
連續同 role 合併、檔名）都由 `renderTranscript()` / `filenameFor()` 處理：

```js
{
  source: 'gemini',
  sourceLabel: 'Gemini',
  title: inner[0][2][1] || 'Gemini conversation',
  url: location.href,
  ids: { conversation_id: 'c_…', share_id: inner[0][3] || '' },
  model: inner[0][2][7]?.[2] || '',      // 例："Flash"
  createdAt: inner[0][4]?.[0],           // epoch 秒，toDate() 直接吃
  sections: [{ role: 'User' | 'Assistant', model, time, body }],
}
```

### 6. UI 與動作

`ACTIONS` / `createExportPanel` / `registerMenu` 照抄 copilot，只改三處：

- `buttonLabel: '⇩ Export MD'`（不變）
- `toggles` 多第三個：`{ label: '含其他候選草稿', get/set → includeDrafts }`，
  `SETTINGS_KEYS = ['includeThinking', 'includeTools', 'includeDrafts']`
- `shareInput.onSubmit = exportFromShareUrl`：`shareIdFromUrl()` 要同時吃
  `gemini.google.com/share/<id>` 與 `share.gemini.google/<code>`；後者無法在本地解析成
  真 id，走 `GM_openInTab` + `PENDING_KEY` 換頁 handoff（同 claude / copilot），
  新分頁載完由 `consumePending()` 自動複製。

`GM_registerMenuCommand` 不要加 `accessKey`（TM 限定）。

### 7. SPA / 啟動

照抄四支共通的 bootstrap：`installNetworkCapture()` → `registerMenu()` →
DOM ready 後 `start()`（`ui.mount()` + `consumePending()` + 用 `MutationObserver`
偵測 `location.href` 變化後重新 `ui.mount()`）。Gemini 換對話不 reload，
但抓資料不依賴 DOM 狀態，所以只要保證 UI 還在即可。

## README

比照 `userscripts/chatgpt-export-markdown/README.md` 的七節結構，Gemini 版要額外寫清楚：

- share 頁（`/share/<id>`）與 app 頁（`/app/<id>`）的資料來源差異，以及為什麼
  share 頁可以自發請求、app 頁不行
- payload 給的是原始 Markdown，所以 API 路徑的輸出比掃 DOM 準
- 掃 DOM 這條會在 frontmatter 的 `title` 與面板狀態列標明「可能不完整」
- `## 測試` 節放下面那行 preview 指令，並註明 preview 測不到攔截層

```text
    24	/* global createExportPanel, downloadText, filenameFor, jsonFence, renderTranscript, sourcesBlock */
    25	
    26	/**
    27	 * 把一整段 Microsoft Copilot 對話匯成 Markdown，格式跟 chatgpt / claude 那兩支一致
    28	 * （SpecStory 風格的 `_**User (ts)**_` / `---` / `_**Assistant**_`），目的是貼給 coding agent。
    29	 *
    30	 * 這支腳本刻意「不把 API 綁死」，因為實測時有一段是黑箱：
    31	 *
    32	 * - 登入中的對話：`/chats/<id>` ＋ `GET /c/api/conversations/<id>/history?api-version=2`
    33	 *   → `{ results: [{ author: { type: 'ai' | 'human' }, content: [...], createdAt }] }`
    34	 * - 分享出來的對話：`/shares/<id>`。匿名開只會拿到「Sign in to Copilot」擋頁，
    35	 *   打 `/c/api/shares/<id>` 回 **401**（endpoint 存在但要登入），
    36	 *   所以**它的回應長什麼樣沒辦法事先確認**。
    37	 *
    38	 * 因應方式：攔下 `/c/api/{shares,conversations}/…` 的所有 JSON，然後**用形狀找訊息列表**
    39	 * （元素同時有 author/sender 與 content 的那個陣列，取最長的），
    40	 * 不假設 top-level key 叫 `results`。成功時會把命中的 URL 與 top-level keys 印到 console，
    41	 * 遇到沒見過的形狀請把那行連同 Download .json 的內容回報。
    42	 */
    43	(function () {
    44	  'use strict';
    45	
    46	  const VERSION = '1.2.0';
    47	  const NS = 'copilot-export-md';
    48	  const EXPORTER = `copilot-export-markdown v${VERSION}`;
    49	  const LOG_PREFIX = '[copilot-export-markdown]';
    50	  const log = (...args) => console.log(LOG_PREFIX, ...args);
    51	
    52	  // 有任何 @grant 就會被 sandbox，頁面的全域要走 unsafeWindow 才看得到。
    53	  const pageWin = typeof unsafeWindow !== 'undefined' ? unsafeWindow : window;
    54	
    55	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 設定
    56	
    57	  const SETTINGS_KEYS = ['includeThinking', 'includeTools'];
    58	  const PENDING_KEY = 'pendingExport'; // 「貼 share URL → 開新分頁自動匯出」的一次性交棒
    59	  const settings = { includeThinking: false, includeTools: false };
    60	
    61	  for (const key of SETTINGS_KEYS) {
    62	    settings[key] = GM_getValue(key, settings[key]) === true;
    63	  }
    64	
    65	  function setSetting(key, value) {
    66	    settings[key] = value === true;
    67	    GM_setValue(key, settings[key]);
    68	  }
    69	
    70	  // ------------------------------------------------- 來源 1：攔截網站自己的請求
    71	
    72	  const CAPTURE_URL = /\/c\/api\/(shares|conversations)\//;
    73	  const DEFAULT_TITLE = 'Copilot conversation';
    74	  /** [{ url, data, messages }]，最新的排最後。 */
    75	  const captured = [];
    76	  let capturedAuth = null;
    77	
    78	  /** 深掃找「訊息列表」：元素同時有 author/sender 與 content 的陣列，取最長的那個。 */
    79	  function findMessageList(root, maxDepth = 6) {
    80	    const seen = new Set();
    81	    let best = null;
    82	
    83	    const isMessage = (item) =>
    84	      !!item &&
    85	      typeof item === 'object' &&
    86	      (item.author || item.sender || item.role) &&
    87	      (Array.isArray(item.content) || typeof item.content === 'string' || 'text' in item);
    88	
    89	    const walk = (node, depth) => {
    90	      if (!node || typeof node !== 'object' || depth > maxDepth || seen.has(node)) return;
    91	      seen.add(node);
    92	      if (Array.isArray(node)) {
    93	        if (node.length > 0 && node.every(isMessage)) {
    94	          if (!best || node.length > best.length) best = node;
    95	          return;
    96	        }
    97	        for (const item of node) walk(item, depth + 1);
    98	        return;
    99	      }
   100	      for (const value of Object.values(node)) walk(value, depth + 1);
   101	    };
   102	
   103	    walk(root, 0);
   104	    return best;
   105	  }
   106	
   107	  function rememberPayload(url, payload) {
   108	    const messages = findMessageList(payload);
   109	    if (!messages) return;
   110	    captured.push({ url, data: payload, messages });
   111	    log('captured conversation:', url, `${messages.length} messages`);
   112	  }
   113	
   114	  function rememberAuth(value) {
   115	    if (typeof value === 'string' && /^Bearer\s+/i.test(value)) capturedAuth = value;
   116	  }
   117	
   118	  function installFetchCapture() {
   119	    const originalFetch = pageWin.fetch;
   120	    if (typeof originalFetch !== 'function' || originalFetch.__copilotExportPatched) return;
   121	
   122	    const patched = function (...args) {
   123	      try {
   124	        const [input, init] = args;
   125	        const headers = init?.headers || (input && input.headers);
   126	        if (headers) {
   127	          const list = headers instanceof Headers ? headers : new Headers(headers);
   128	          rememberAuth(list.get('authorization'));
   129	        }
   130	      } catch {
   131	        /* 取不到 header 不影響主流程 */
   132	      }
   133	
   134	      const promise = originalFetch.apply(this, args);
   135	      return promise.then((response) => {
   136	        try {
   137	          const input = args[0];
   138	          const url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : input?.url || '';
   139	          // body 只能讀一次，一定要 clone，否則網站自己就讀不到了。
   140	          if (response.ok && CAPTURE_URL.test(url)) {
   141	            response
   142	              .clone()
   143	              .json()
   144	              .then((json) => rememberPayload(url, json))
   145	              .catch(() => {});
   146	          }
   147	        } catch {
   148	          /* 攔截失敗不能影響網站本身 */
   149	        }
   150	        return response; // 一定要把原本的 response 還回去
   151	      });
   152	    };
   153	    patched.__copilotExportPatched = true;
   154	    pageWin.fetch = patched;
   155	  }
   156	
   157	  /** Copilot 有些請求走 XHR，所以兩種都要攔。 */
   158	  function installXhrCapture() {
   159	    const XHR = pageWin.XMLHttpRequest;
   160	    if (!XHR || XHR.prototype.__copilotExportPatched) return;
   161	
   162	    const { open, send, setRequestHeader } = XHR.prototype;
   163	
   164	    XHR.prototype.open = function (method, url, ...rest) {
   165	      this.__copilotExportUrl = String(url || '');
   166	      return open.call(this, method, url, ...rest);
   167	    };
   168	
   169	    XHR.prototype.setRequestHeader = function (name, value) {
   170	      if (String(name).toLowerCase() === 'authorization') rememberAuth(value);
   171	      return setRequestHeader.call(this, name, value);
   172	    };
   173	
   174	    XHR.prototype.send = function (...args) {
   175	      this.addEventListener('load', () => {
   176	        try {
   177	          const url = this.__copilotExportUrl || '';
   178	          if (this.status < 200 || this.status >= 300 || !CAPTURE_URL.test(url)) return;
   179	          const raw =
   180	            this.responseType === '' || this.responseType === 'text'
   181	              ? this.responseText
   182	              : this.response;
   183	          rememberPayload(url, typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw);
   184	        } catch {
   185	          /* 不是 JSON 就算了 */
   186	        }
   187	      });
   188	      return send.apply(this, args);
   189	    };
   190	
   191	    XHR.prototype.__copilotExportPatched = true;
   192	  }
   193	
   194	  // ------------------------------------------------------- 來源 2：自己打 API
   195	
   196	  const delay = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
   197	
   198	  function pickCaptured({ chatId, shareId }) {
   199	    const id = shareId || chatId;
   200	    if (id) {
   201	      for (let i = captured.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   202	        if (captured[i].url.includes(id)) return captured[i];
   203	      }
   204	    }
   205	    return captured[captured.length - 1] || null;
   206	  }
   207	
   208	  async function waitForCapture(ids, { timeout = 8_000, interval = 200 } = {}) {
   209	    const deadline = Date.now() + timeout;
   210	    for (;;) {
   211	      const hit = pickCaptured(ids);
   212	      if (hit) return hit;
   213	      if (Date.now() >= deadline) return null;
   214	      await delay(interval);
   215	    }
   216	  }
   217	
   218	  /** 暖一下 session。公開的 Copilot exporter 都這樣做，401 之後再試一次常常就過了。 */
   219	  async function warmSession() {
   220	    try {
   221	      await fetch('/c/api/start', { method: 'POST', credentials: 'include' });
   222	    } catch {
   223	      /* 暖不起來就直接試 */
   224	    }
   225	  }
   226	
   227	  async function fromApi({ chatId, shareId }) {
   228	    const paths = [];
   229	    if (shareId) paths.push(`/c/api/shares/${shareId}`, `/c/api/shares/${shareId}?api-version=2`);
   230	    if (chatId) paths.push(`/c/api/conversations/${chatId}/history?api-version=2`);
   231	
   232	    for (const path of paths) {
   233	      for (const attempt of [1, 2]) {
   234	        try {
   235	          const headers = { accept: 'application/json' };
   236	          if (capturedAuth) headers.authorization = capturedAuth;
   237	          const res = await fetch(path, { credentials: 'include', headers });
   238	          if (!res.ok) {
   239	            log('api fallback failed:', path, res.status);
   240	            if (attempt === 1 && (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403)) {
   241	              await warmSession();
   242	              continue;
   243	            }
   244	            break;
   245	          }
   246	          const json = await res.json();
   247	          const messages = findMessageList(json);
   248	          if (messages) return { url: path, data: json, messages };
   249	          break;
   250	        } catch (error) {
   251	          log('api fallback threw:', error.message);
   252	          break;
   253	        }
   254	      }
   255	    }
   256	    return null;
   257	  }
   258	
   259	  // ------------------------------------------------------------ 來源總調度
   260	
   261	  function currentIds() {
   262	    const chat = location.pathname.match(/\/chats\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/);
   263	    const share = location.pathname.match(/^\/shares\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/);
   264	    return { chatId: chat?.[1] || null, shareId: share?.[1] || null };
   265	  }
   266	
   267	  function shareIdFromUrl(input) {
   268	    const match = String(input).match(/\/shares\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/);
   269	    return match ? match[1] : null;
   270	  }
   271	
   272	  async function resolveConversation(ids) {
   273	    const hit = pickCaptured(ids) || (await waitForCapture(ids));
   274	    if (hit) return { ...hit, source: 'network-capture' };
   275	
   276	    const api = await fromApi(ids);
   277	    if (api) return { ...api, source: 'api' };
   278	
   279	    throw new Error('抓不到對話資料。請確認已登入、對話已載完，再重新整理這一頁試一次。');
   280	  }
   281	
   282	  // ------------------------------------------------------------ 轉成 Markdown
   283	
   284	  function roleOf(message) {
   285	    const type = String(
   286	      message.author?.type || message.author || message.sender || message.role || ''
   287	    );
   288	    if (/human|user/i.test(type)) return 'User';
   289	    if (/^(ai|bot|assistant|copilot)$/i.test(type)) return 'Assistant';
   290	    return type ? type[0].toUpperCase() + type.slice(1) : 'Unknown';
   291	  }
   292	
   293	  function partToText(part, opts, citations) {
   294	    if (typeof part === 'string') return part;
   295	    if (!part || typeof part !== 'object') return '';
   296	
   297	    switch (part.type) {
   298	      case 'text':
   299	        return String(part.text ?? '');
   300	      case 'image': {
   301	        if (!part.url) return '';
   302	        const caption = part.prompt ? `\n\n*Prompt: ${part.prompt}*` : '';
   303	        return `![image](${part.url})${caption}`;
   304	      }
   305	      case 'citation':
   306	        if (part.url) citations.push({ url: part.url, title: part.title || '' });
   307	        return '';
   308	      case 'chainOfThought': {
   309	        if (!opts.includeThinking) return '';
   310	        const shot = part.screenshotUrl ? `\n\n![screenshot](${part.screenshotUrl})` : '';
   311	        return `${String(part.text ?? '')}${shot}`;
   312	      }
   313	      default:
   314	        // 沒見過的 part。預設不塞進正文（避免整篇被 tool 雜訊淹掉），
   315	        // 但打開「含工具呼叫」時原樣留 JSON，不靜默丟掉。
   316	        if (!opts.includeTools) return '';
   317	        return `**${part.type || 'part'}**\n\n${jsonFence(part)}`;
   318	    }
   319	  }
   320	
   321	  function messageToBody(message, opts) {
   322	    const citations = [];
   323	    const parts = Array.isArray(message.content)
   324	      ? message.content
   325	      : message.content
   326	        ? [message.content]
   327	        : [];
   328	
   329	    const texts = parts
   330	      .map((part) => partToText(part, opts, citations))
   331	      .filter((text) => String(text).trim());
   332	
   333	    if (texts.length === 0 && typeof message.text === 'string' && message.text.trim()) {
   334	      texts.push(message.text);
   335	    }
   336	
   337	    const sources = sourcesBlock(citations);
   338	    if (sources) texts.push(sources);
   339	    return texts.join('\n\n');
   340	  }
   341	
   342	  /**
   343	   * `/c/api/conversations/<id>/history` 的回應裡沒有標題，
   344	   * 標題在對話列表那支 API 上。拿不到就算了，frontmatter 留預設值。
   345	   */
   346	  async function lookupTitle(chatId) {
   347	    try {
   348	      const headers = { accept: 'application/json' };
   349	      if (capturedAuth) headers.authorization = capturedAuth;
   350	      const res = await fetch('/c/api/conversations?api-version=2', {
   351	        credentials: 'include',
   352	        headers,
   353	      });
   354	      if (!res.ok) return '';
   355	      const json = await res.json();
   356	      const items = Array.isArray(json?.results) ? json.results : Array.isArray(json) ? json : [];
   357	      return items.find((item) => item?.id === chatId)?.title || '';
   358	    } catch {
   359	      return '';
   360	    }
   361	  }
   362	
   363	  /** title 藏在哪一層不確定，往下找兩層就好。 */
   364	  function pickTitle(data) {
   365	    const keys = ['title', 'conversationTitle', 'name', 'snapshotName'];
   366	    const look = (node, depth) => {
   367	      if (!node || typeof node !== 'object' || depth > 2) return '';
   368	      for (const key of keys) {
   369	        if (typeof node[key] === 'string' && node[key].trim()) return node[key];
   370	      }
   371	      for (const value of Object.values(node)) {
   372	        if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {
   373	          const hit = look(value, depth + 1);
   374	          if (hit) return hit;
   375	        }
   376	      }
   377	      return '';
   378	    };
   379	    return look(data, 0) || DEFAULT_TITLE;
   380	  }
   381	
   382	  function normalize(hit, ctx, opts) {
   383	    const messages = [...hit.messages].sort((a, b) => {
   384	      const at = new Date(a.createdAt || a.created_at || 0).getTime() || 0;
   385	      const bt = new Date(b.createdAt || b.created_at || 0).getTime() || 0;
   386	      return at - bt;
   387	    });
   388	
   389	    const sections = messages
   390	      .map((message) => ({
   391	        role: roleOf(message),
   392	        model: '',
   393	        time: message.createdAt || message.created_at,
   394	        body: messageToBody(message, opts),
   395	      }))
   396	      .filter((section) => section.body.trim());
   397	
   398	    return {
   399	      source: 'copilot',
   400	      sourceLabel: 'Microsoft Copilot',
   401	      title: pickTitle(hit.data),
   402	      url: ctx.url,
   403	      ids: { conversation_id: ctx.chatId || '', share_id: ctx.shareId || '' },
   404	      model: '',
   405	      createdAt: messages[0]?.createdAt || messages[0]?.created_at,
   406	      sections,
   407	    };
   408	  }

   410	  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ 動作

   412	  async function doExport({ mode, to, ids }) {
   413	    ui.setStatus('讀取對話…');
   414	    try {
   415	      const target = ids || currentIds();
   416	      const hit = await resolveConversation(target);
   417	      const url = target.shareId ? `${location.origin}/shares/${target.shareId}` : location.href;
   418	      // 這一行就是把「/c/api/shares/<id> 到底長怎樣」收斂掉的手段，不要拿掉。
   419	      log('using payload from', hit.url, '| top-level keys:', Object.keys(hit.data || {}));
   420	
   421	      const doc = normalize(hit, { ...target, url }, settings);
   422	      if (doc.title === DEFAULT_TITLE && target.chatId) {
   423	        doc.title = (await lookupTitle(target.chatId)) || doc.title;
   424	      }
   425	      const text =
   426	        mode === 'json'
   427	          ? JSON.stringify(hit.data, null, 2)
   428	          : renderTranscript(doc, {
   429	              ...settings,
   430	              handoff: mode === 'handoff',
   431	              exporter: EXPORTER,
   432	            });
   433	
   434	      if (to === 'clipboard') {
   435	        GM_setClipboard(text, 'text');
   436	        ui.setStatus(`已複製 ${text.length.toLocaleString()} 字（來源：${hit.source}）`);
   437	      } else {
   438	        downloadText(
   439	          filenameFor(doc, mode === 'json' ? 'json' : 'md'),
   440	          text,
   441	          mode === 'json' ? 'application/json;charset=utf-8' : 'text/markdown;charset=utf-8'
   442	        );
   443	        ui.setStatus(`已下載（來源：${hit.source}）`);
   444	      }
   445	      log('exported', { mode, to, source: hit.source, length: text.length });
   446	    } catch (error) {
   447	      ui.setStatus(`失敗：${error.message}`);
   448	      log('export failed:', error);
   449	    }
   450	  }
   451	
   452	  /** share 的內容要登入 session 才看得到，所以一律開分頁讓那邊的腳本自己抓。 */
   453	  function exportFromShareUrl(raw) {
   454	    const shareId = shareIdFromUrl(raw);
   455	    if (!shareId) {
   456	      ui.setStatus('這不像 share URL（要有 /shares/<id>）。');
   457	      return;
   458	    }
   459	    if (shareId === currentIds().shareId) {
   460	      doExport({ mode: 'transcript', to: 'clipboard' });
   461	      return;
   462	    }
   463	    GM_setValue(PENDING_KEY, { shareId, expires: Date.now() + 120_000 });
   464	    GM_openInTab(`${location.origin}/shares/${shareId}`, { active: true });
   465	    ui.setStatus('已開新分頁，那邊載完就會自動複製。');
   466	  }
   467	
   468	  async function consumePending() {
   469	    const pending = GM_getValue(PENDING_KEY, null);
   470	    if (!pending || typeof pending !== 'object') return;
   471	    const { shareId } = currentIds();
   472	    if (!shareId || pending.shareId !== shareId) return;
   473	
   474	    GM_deleteValue(PENDING_KEY); // 一次性：先消耗再執行，免得失敗時每次開頁都重跑
   475	    if (Date.now() > (pending.expires ?? 0)) return;
   476	
   477	    ui.openPanel();
   478	    await doExport({ mode: 'transcript', to: 'clipboard' });
   479	  }
```

```text
  /** 把 render 過的 HTML 轉回 Markdown。 */
  function nodeToMarkdown(node, depth = 0) {
    if (node.nodeType === 3) return (node.nodeValue || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
    if (node.nodeType !== 1) return '';

    const tag = node.tagName.toLowerCase();
    const kids = () =>
      Array.from(node.childNodes)
        .map((child) => nodeToMarkdown(child, depth))
        .join('');

    switch (tag) {
      // 純互動元素不是內容，帶進去只會變雜訊
      case 'script':
      case 'style':
      case 'svg':
      case 'button':
      case 'textarea':
        return '';
      case 'br':
        return '\n';
      case 'hr':
        return '\n\n---\n\n';
      // 空的行內標記要整個丟掉，不然畫面上的 icon/spacer 會變成一堆孤兒 `**`
      case 'strong':
      case 'b': {
        const text = kids().trim();
        return text ? `**${text}**` : '';
      }
      case 'em':
      case 'i': {
        const text = kids().trim();
        return text ? `*${text}*` : '';
      }
      case 'del':
      case 's': {
        const text = kids().trim();
        return text ? `~~${text}~~` : '';
      }
      case 'a': {
        const href = node.getAttribute('href') || '';
        const text = kids().trim();
        return href && text ? `[${text}](${href})` : text;
      }
      case 'img':
        return `![image](${node.getAttribute('src') || ''})`;
      case 'code': {
        // <pre><code> 由 pre 那邊整塊處理，這裡只管行內的
        if (node.parentElement && node.parentElement.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'pre') return kids();
        const text = kids().trim();
        return text ? `\`${text}\`` : '';
      }
      case 'pre': {
        const className = node.querySelector('code')?.className || '';
        const lang = /language-([\w+-]+)/.exec(className)?.[1] || '';
        return `\n\n\`\`\`${lang}\n${(node.textContent || '').replace(/\n+$/, '')}\n\`\`\`\n\n`;
      }
      case 'h1':
      case 'h2':
      case 'h3':
      case 'h4':
      case 'h5':
      case 'h6':
        return `\n\n${'#'.repeat(Number(tag[1]))} ${kids().trim()}\n\n`;
      case 'blockquote':
        return `\n\n> ${kids().trim().replace(/\n/g, '\n> ')}\n\n`;
      case 'ul':

          (child) => child.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'li'
```
